title: November Examination: Paper 1
instructions: This paper consists of SEVEN questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Clearly show ALL calculations, diagrams and graphs that you used in determining your answers.
You may use an approved scientific calculator unless stated otherwise.
Round off answers to TWO decimal places, unless stated otherwise.

questions.prompt: Solve for $x$: $x(x - 4) = 12$
Solve for $x$, correct to two decimal places: $2x^2 - 7x + 2 = 0$
Solve for $x$: $x^2 - 3x - 10 \leq 0$
Solve for $x$ without a calculator: $3^{2x} - 4 \cdot 3^x + 3 = 0$
Find $T_{50}$ of the arithmetic sequence $-3; 1; 5; 9; \ldots$
Calculate $\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{40}(5k - 2)$
The first term of a geometric series is 54 and its sum to infinity is 81. Find the common ratio and the third term.
For which values of $x$ will $\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{\infty}(x - 2)^k$ converge?
The sum of the first $n$ terms of a sequence is $S_n = n^2 + 3n$. (a) Find $T_1$ and $T_2$. (b) Show that the sequence is arithmetic and find $T_n$.
questions.memo:
(a) ✓ $T_1 = S_1 = 4$ (1) ✓ $S_2 = 10$, so $T_2 = 6$ (1)
(b) ✓ $T_n = S_n - S_{n-1} = 2n + 2$ (2) ✓ Constant difference $d = 2$, so arithmetic (1)

questions.prompt: Write down the equation of $f^{-1}$ in the form $y = \ldots$
Write down the domain of $f^{-1}$.
For which value of $x$ is $f^{-1}(x) = 3$?
Explain why the inverse of $g$ is not a function, and suggest a restriction on the domain of $g$ so that $g^{-1}$ is a function.
questions.memo:
✓ $g$ is many-to-one, e.g. $g(1) = g(-1) = 3$ (1)
✓ so its inverse fails the vertical line test (1)
✓ Restrict to $x \geq 0$ (or $x \leq 0$) (1)

questions.prompt: Determine $g^{-1}(x)$ for the restriction $x \geq 0$.

Nandi takes out a home loan of R850 000 at 10,5% p.a. compounded monthly, repayable over 20 years with equal monthly payments starting one month after the loan is granted. Calculate the monthly payment, to the nearest cent.
Musa deposits R2 000 at the end of every month into an account earning 7,5% p.a. compounded monthly. What will the account be worth after 10 years? Give the answer to the nearest rand.
How long, in years, will it take for an investment to triple at 8% p.a. compounded quarterly?
Find the remainder when $x^3 - 4x^2 + 2x + 5$ is divided by $x - 3$.
Factorise $f(x) = x^3 - 3x^2 - 4x + 12$ fully, and solve $f(x) = 0$.
$g(x) = 2x^3 + ax^2 - 7x + b$ has a factor $(x - 1)$, and leaves a remainder of $13$ when divided by $(x - 2)$. Determine $a$ and $b$.
Determine $f'(x)$ from first principles if $f(x) = 3x^2$.
Determine the coordinates of the turning points of $h$.
Determine the $x$-coordinate of the point of inflection of $h$.
Determine the equation of the tangent to $h$ at $x = 0$.
For which values of $x$ is $h$ decreasing?
A rectangular garden of area 200 m² is to be fenced on three sides (the fourth side is a wall). Find the dimensions that use the least fencing.
questions.memo:
✓ Let the sides perpendicular to the wall be $x$; parallel side $\frac{200}{x}$ (1)
✓ $L = 2x + \frac{200}{x}$ (1)
✓ $L'(x) = 2 - \frac{200}{x^2} = 0$ (1)
✓ $x = 10$ m (1)
✓ Dimensions 10 m by 20 m (1)

questions.prompt: How many different arrangements are there of the letters of the word PARALLEL?
Seven books, including 3 Maths books, are placed on a shelf. In how many ways can they be arranged if the Maths books must be together?
A 3-digit code is formed from the digits 1 to 7 without repetition. What is the probability that the code is greater than 500?
Events A and B are independent, $P(A) = 0{,}3$ and $P(A \text{ or } B) = 0{,}58$. Find $P(B)$.
